request.business_problem: New engineers spend their first weeks asking where docs live, how to set up repos and what the team conventions are.
request.tasks: An onboarding plugin: a docs search server over the team's markdown handbook folder (search and read, nothing outside the folder), a skill that builds a personalised first-week plan from role and stack, and a reviewer subagent that checks a new engineer's setup notes against the handbook.
request.required_output: A first-week plan citing handbook pages by path; review feedback citing the handbook.
request.examples: Handbook pages: setup/laptop.md, conventions/git-flow.md, conventions/code-review.md, oncall/runbook.md

smoke.prompt: Search the handbook for our git workflow and tell me which page to read first.
